recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-15946 unless future work changes DeviceRequest.intent away from code or weakens/removes its request-intent binding.
issue_request: FHIR-15946 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking to change DeviceRequest.intent from CodeableConcept to code because request intent uses a fixed vocabulary and comparable request resources already used code.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-15946 or GF#15946 was found in the current local git history. The current build-source layout introduced DeviceRequest.intent already typed as code in c69d71a and the later source rework 33b409a preserved that datatype with the request-intent binding.
additional_context: DeviceUseRequest became DeviceRequest, and DeviceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. OO minutes and the matching Zulip block-vote notice list tracker 15946 as Persuasive. Same-family FHIR-15954 for ServiceRequest.intent and same-element FHIR-19563 for the DeviceRequest.intent binding URL are already represented on the combined branch, so they were not republished here.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active DeviceRequest StructureDefinition already defines DeviceRequest.intent as type code and binds it to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent.

related_jiras.note: Analogous Published/Persuasive ServiceRequest.intent datatype issue; already audited on the combined branch and useful as background for Request.intent alignment.
Applied/Persuasive issue for the DeviceRequest.intent binding URL; already audited on the combined branch and confirms the current request-intent ValueSet URL.
